sanskrit_verse: भृताय वेतनं दद्यात् कर्मस्वामी यथाक्रमम् । आदौ मध्ये अवसाने वा कर्मणो यद् विनिश्चितम् ॥
transliteration: bhṛtāya vetanaṃ dadyāt karmasvāmī yathākramam ādau madhye 'vasāne vā karmaṇo yad viniścitam
sph_interpretive_translation: The employer shall provide compensation to the worker in accordance with the sequence of work—whether at the beginning, during, or at the conclusion of the task—as determined by the nature of the duty itself.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from capacity to sustain and enable labor
Causation is rooted in the integrity of work completion
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with sequential engagement
Restoration logic demands fulfillment of contractual consciousness
Consciousness alignment occurs through honoring mutual obligation
executable_legal_axioms: IF a labor contract exists THEN compensation MUST align with work-phase delivery
IF work initiation occurs THEN initial compensation assurance IS binding
IF mid-process evaluation shows deviation THEN corrective resource allocation SHALL occur
IF work concludes without dispute THEN final settlement MUST execute automatically
IF consciousness misalignment detected THEN restorative dialogue protocol SHALL activate
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that employer liability is not temporal but ontological—rooted in the very act of engaging labor. The court must ensure that compensation structures reflect the tripartite integrity of labor engagement: commencement, continuation, and conclusion. Responsibility arises not from external enforcement but from the conscious agreement entered into by both parties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that compensation arises directly from the act of labor engagement. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates that responsibility unfolds sequentially with each phase of work. Proportional responsibility lies in matching payment to performance integrity. The non-punitive reality rule holds that failure to compensate distorts dharma not through penalty but through disrupted consciousness flow between individuals and society.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate compensation alignment audit upon labor completion
Activate bilateral consciousness restoration session if imbalance reported
Deploy economic-equilibrium restoration mechanism via third-party mediation
Reintegrate worker’s financial autonomy through structured repayment plan
Verify energetic closure between employer and employee post-resolution
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands executed: labor honored, duty fulfilled, consciousness restored. There is no punishment, only realignment. Dharma prevails.
